summary.text: Dawson Holle is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 31 since December 1, 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Holle was born in Bismarck, North Dakota, according to Ballotpedia, and his career experience includes working as a dairy farmer.
Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session as the House Human Services Committee and the House Political Subdivisions Committee.
